title: Supreme Court gives Centre four-week leeway to respond to petition on airfare hike, says govt. handling ‘bigger problems now’ - The Hindu
summary: The Supreme Court granted the government a four-week extension to respond to a petition regarding airfare hikes and cancellations, citing evolving international situations possibly linked to the Iran-Israel conflict. The petition also highlighted issues with fare transparency and the need for regulatory intervention in the civil aviation sector.
sentiment_reason: The mention of the Supreme Court's decision to delay the case due to 'evolving international situations' and the reference to the ongoing Iran-Israel conflict implies negative market impact due to potential instability and uncertainty.
